arguments.name: Collins conditional comparative route with explicit version limits
premises: Life-permitting conditions expected under a good life-valuing designer.
They are improbable under a selected single-universe epistemic measure.
bridge_principles: Likelihood comparison; illuminated-range and parameterization defense.
arguments.conclusion: Conditional comparative support, not final theism or a verified designer.
arguments.strongest_objection: Observation selection and unestablished measures/preferences; moving from a finite illuminated comparison to an all-reality conclusion needs care.
arguments.strongest_reply: Collins restates existence evidence and defends epistemic probability; Sober grants a trace inequality but disputes which conditioned observation is relevant.
unresolved_issues: Goodness cannot receive independent evidential credit from its own assumption.
arguments.inference_scope: Conditional argument assessment only; premise truth and all hypothesis components unresolved.

arguments.name: White–Weisberg direct probability disagreement
premises: White(4): life less likely with stringent laws without design.
White(5): equal life likelihood across stringency given design.
White(6): stringency not evidence against design before life.
bridge_principles: Bayesian conditional update with defined probabilities.
arguments.conclusion: Added stringency support follows conditionally; third-premise rationale remains contested.
arguments.strongest_objection: Weisberg’s judge counterexample and matched distributions undermine the no-known-preference rationale.
arguments.strongest_reply: White shows low absolute designer likelihood does not negate a comparative advantage; Dorst later supplies a distinct stringency-class weighting.
unresolved_issues: No independent actual distribution or designer preference established.
Weisberg2010andBradley2012 originals omitted; not needed to impersonate2012attribution as independent2010coverage.

arguments.name: Dorst mixture extension and its residual model dependence
premises: Divine Intent and blind life-world indifference.
Possible ideal stringency-class distribution gives sigma(S)>lambda(S).
Reasonable credence defers to ideal distributions and gives sufficient weight to that possibility.
bridge_principles: Total probability including Else, plus lowerbound wS*sigma(S)>lambda(S).
arguments.conclusion: Conditional positive support can survive uncertainty and some deviations from exact indifference.
arguments.strongest_objection: The supplied McCutcheon manuscript adds uncertainty over the laxity range; under its uniform hyperprior the claimed giant ratio falls to about 61, and under a family of power priors it becomes approximately neutral in a limit. Thus a tiny sufficient mixture weight is not secured by indifference uncertainty alone.
arguments.strongest_reply: The actual 2022 reply includes Else and defends a lower bound and sensitivity to departures preserving likelihood separation. That sufficient condition remains valid. A defense of a fixed range or a different proper hyperprior would require further justification; this is a researcher-identified possible response, not an actual reply to the 2026 manuscript.
unresolved_issues: Collins2003 numerical premise not independently inspected/validated.
Deference and metaphysical weight motivations remain contested.
Typeset anomalies require explicit intended-formula reconstruction.
No actual reply to McCutcheon found by separate capped pass; absence of discovery is not absence of reply.
The 2026 critique is inspected in exact supplied bytes, with version-number uncertainty. No actual later reply was found by Q015.
Missing normalized endpoint and retained-term qualifications are specified in mathematical_checks.md; neither side establishes a unique actual measure.

arguments.name: Sober time-indexed observation-selection critique
premises: Earlier living observer implies life-compatible stable constants.
The later observation process is conditioned on earlier life rather than its own outcome.
bridge_principles: Time-indexed process/product distinction and conditional likelihood comparison.
arguments.conclusion: The selected observation need not discriminate between ID and Chance despite an unconditioned trace inequality.
arguments.strongest_objection: The conditioning basis is disputed and compatibility is not the same datum as learned stringency; firing-squad analogy requires separate chronology.
arguments.strongest_reply: Sober revises the firing-squad verdict while preserving earlier-life conditioning for stable constants; rejects an indiscriminate recipe against all design evidence.
unresolved_issues: Does not remove every qualitative relation.
arguments.inference_scope: Conditional argument assessment only; premise truth and all hypothesis components unresolved.

arguments.name: Range uncertainty challenges the scale of the mixture advantage
premises: Laxity range parameter x is uncertain.
Conditional life-world density is 2t/x²; stringency-class density is 1/x on (0,x).
A shared uniform or normalized power hyperprior supplies the relevant marginal likelihoods.
bridge_principles: Marginalize over x before evaluating the observed interval.
Use defined proper priors or explicitly qualified limiting ratios, preserving normalization and endpoint terms.
arguments.conclusion: The extreme fixed-range ratio is sensitive to additional range uncertainty. The broad conclusion of universal evidential neutrality is not established.
arguments.strongest_objection: The hyperprior and interpretation of x are additional assumptions. The uniform example retains positive support; the exact improper endpoint is unavailable, and neglected small terms can determine the sign near neutrality.
arguments.strongest_reply: The manuscript motivates uncertainty over x and a multiplicative independent-hoops prior; its proper finite-p examples already erode the enormous ratio without needing an improper endpoint. These are actual manuscript replies to its uniform-prior limitation, not a later response from Dorst.
unresolved_issues: No independently established cosmic hyperprior, physical measure or designer preference.
No actual response to this 2026 critique found in the capped dedicated forward pass.
Source version number remains unauthenticated; supplied attribution/bytes disclosed.
